L29: The goal of our Access to Water Program is to provide reliable, equitable access to clean, safe drinking water in the public realm, achieved by:
L34: Access to Water is supported through both temporary and permanent drinking fountains, handwashing and misting stations across the city.
L40: Vancouver has hundreds of permanent drinking fountains, the majority of which operate seasonally.
L41: To ensure year-round equitable access to drinking water, all new fountains are installing freeze-proof models that remain functional year-round and we are updating older, seasonal, or inaccessible fountains with new freeze-proof models through our capital renewal plan. This infrastructure promotes health and wellness across our various communities while also supporting sustainability efforts by reducing waste across the city.
L42:  All new drinking fountains, handwashing stations and misting stations are equipped with bottle fillers.
L55: The map below shows where you can find all locations for public access to drinking water.

L31: Vancouver skateboard parks are located around the city and bring bowls, ramps, hipboxes and street-style layouts for all levels.
L33: Skateboard parks are open to everyone.
L83: Coopers' Skateboard Spot is located at North False Creek under the Cambie Street Bridge. Learn more about the features of the park.
L97: The Leeside Tunnel Skateboard Park is located under the Cassiar St Connector. Learn more about the park, and its features.

L30: The Vancouver Heritage Register (VHR) is a list of buildings and structures that are formally recognized by Council for their heritage value.
L32: As a land use planning tool, the VHR helps guide staff and Council in making informed decisions, making sure our diverse heritage is integrated into future planning and development.
L53: VHR listings are organized by street address in a table. Numbered avenues are followed by streets, listed in alphabetical order.
L55: If a building has an historic name or association, it may be listed in the building name/specifics column. Any formal recognition or legal protection is indicated by the notations shown in this table.
